findings.claim: Dream and Consciousness used the LLM/GPU concurrently; the timeline reports GPU 86-92%, load 7.3-8.2 and growing llama-server RSS while Dream replay JSON parsing failed and later synthesis/consolidation continued.
findings.implication: H1/H2/H3 need explicit inference-resource scheduling/contention tests and must separate model-format failure from resource starvation/parallel-load effects.

findings.claim: A deep-reflection E-PQ empathy/mood update was reported in one path while periodic 60-second E-PQ samples remained unchanged, indicating either sampling visibility, overwrite, persistence or invariants reconciliation ambiguity.
findings.implication: State mutations and sampled readouts need epoch/event identity so silent overwrite or sampling blindness can be distinguished by replay.

findings.claim: A Dream reflection path recorded mood_before=0.0 and mood_after=0.0 despite surrounding consciousness mood near 0.59, suggesting default/null-path or cross-store state inconsistency.
findings.implication: Missing/default state must be typed distinctly from a real zero value; cross-module state reads require source/epoch consistency checks.

findings.claim: Genesis was killed by its watchdog after a five-minute timeout and restarted, providing a concrete crash/restart point inside the fused causal timeline.
findings.implication: Recovery tests should prove post-restart state continuity/idempotence and distinguish watchdog health failure from semantic module failure.

earned_work.reason: Corroborates existing audit liveness/runtime/state oracles; retained only for temporal cross-stream test specificity.
